Messages.Author: Jazzbeaux
Messages.Body:
When Cleave is used to create a melee weapon, is that weapon Equipment?
The reason to ask is obviously the various cards that stop Equipment
working, and the fact that both Weighted Walking Stick and Zip Gun
specifically say they are Equipment when they come into play and this
does not.
Thanks,
Sam

Cleave [NoR:C]
Cardtype: Combat
Virtue: Vengeance
Choose a melee weapon this imbued has or spend 1 conviction to put this
card on this imbued to represent a melee weapon that does strength
damage each strike. This melee weapon inflicts +1 additional damage
[this action]. If the opposing minion is (or becomes) immune to
non-aggravated damage, he or she loses that immunity for handling
damage from this weapon. Burn the melee weapon at the end of the
action.

Weighted Walking Stick
Type: Combat
Only usable before range is determined on the first round.
Put this card on this minion and put 5 counters on this card. While in
play, this card represents a melee weapon (and counts as equipment
while in play). This weapon does strength+1 damage each strike. For
each point of damage inflicted by this strike (even if it is
prevented), remove a counter from this card. Burn this card when it has
no counters. A minion can have only 1 Weighted Walking Stick.

Zip Gun
Type: Combat
Before range is determined, put this card on this minion. This card
represents an equipment card and doesn't count as a combat card while
in play. This equipment is a Weapon, Gun. Ammo cards cannot be used
with this gun. It does 1R damage each strike, with an optional maneuver
each combat. Bearer takes 1 damage during strike resolution when this
gun is used, but only once each combat. This card is kept as normal
equipment and is not discarded after combat.

Messages.Author: OrgPlay
Messages.Body:


Weapons are equipment by default.

Much like guns are weapons by default

oscar

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
OrgPlay wrote:
> Jazzbeaux wrote:
> > When Cleave is used to create a melee weapon, is that weapon Equipment?
>

> Weapons are equipment by default.

Correct.

Similarly, vampires are minions by default. The vampire created by The
Embrace is a minion.

(Not sure if "by default" is right there -- there're no exceptions to
override the defaults, so "by definition" may be more appropriate, for
both cases).
